import sys
import heapq

N = 100010
M = 1000010
inf = 1000000000
winf = 1000000000

class Road:
    def __init__(self, nxt=0, to=0, f=0, w=0):
        self.nxt = nxt
        self.to = to
        self.f = f
        self.w = w

r = [Road() for _ in range(M << 1)]
head = [0] * N
cnt = 1
all_nodes = 0

def add(u, v, f, w):
    global cnt
    cnt += 1
    r[cnt] = Road(head[u], v, f, w)
    head[u] = cnt
    cnt += 1
    r[cnt] = Road(head[v], u, 0, -w)
    head[v] = cnt

class MinCostFlow:
    def __init__(self, all_nodes):
        self.cur = [0] * N
        self.vis = [False] * N
        self.dis = [0] * N
        self.tag = [0] * N
        self.all = all_nodes
        self.maxf = 0
        self.minw = 0

    class Node:
        def __init__(self, u=0, v=0):
            self.u = u
            self.v = v
        def __lt__(self, other):
            return self.v > other.v

    def dij(self, s, t):
        for i in range(1, self.all + 1):
            self.dis[i] = winf
            self.cur[i] = head[i]
        self.dis[t] = 0
        q = []
        heapq.heappush(q, self.Node(t, 0))
        while q:
            u_node = heapq.heappop(q)
            u = u_node.u
            if self.vis[u]:
                continue
            self.vis[u] = True
            i = head[u]
            while i:
                v = r[i].to
                w = self.tag[u] + r[i ^ 1].w - self.tag[v]
                if r[i ^ 1].f and self.dis[u] + w < self.dis[v]:
                    self.dis[v] = self.dis[u] + w
                    heapq.heappush(q, self.Node(v, self.dis[v]))
                i = r[i].nxt
        for i in range(1, self.all + 1):
            self.tag[i] = min(self.tag[i] + self.dis[i], winf)
        if not self.vis[s]:
            return False
        for i in range(1, self.all + 1):
            self.vis[i] = False
        return True

    def dfs(self, u, t, fl):
        if u == t or not fl:
            return fl
        res = 0
        self.vis[u] = True
        i = self.cur[u]
        while i:
            if r[i].f:
                v = r[i].to
                f = 0
                if not self.vis[v] and self.tag[v] + r[i].w == self.tag[u]:
                    f = self.dfs(v, t, min(fl, r[i].f))
                if f:
                    r[i].f -= f
                    r[i ^ 1].f += f
                    res += f
                    fl -= f
                    if not fl:
                        break
            i = r[i].nxt
        self.vis[u] = False
        return res

    def work(self, s, t):
        while self.dij(s, t):
            w = self.dfs(s, t, inf)
            self.maxf += w
            self.minw += w * self.tag[s]

def main():
    global all_nodes
    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n_, m_, k_, c_, d_ = map(int, input[0:5])
    n = n_
    m = m_
    k = k_
    c = c_
    d = d_
    all_nodes = n + 2
    g = [[] for _ in range(N)]
    index = 5
    for _ in range(k):
        a = int(input[index])
        index += 1
        add(0, id(0, a), 1, 0)
    for _ in range(m):
        u = int(input[index])
        v = int(input[index + 1])
        index += 2
        g[u].append(v)
        g[v].append(u)
    def id(t, x):
        return t * n + x + 2
    add(id(0, 1), all_nodes - 1, inf, 0)
    def work(t):
        nonlocal all_nodes
        all_nodes += n
        for u in range(1, n + 1):
            for v in g[u]:
                for p in range(1, k + 1):
                    add(id(t, u), id(t + 1, v), 1, d * (2 * p - 1))
        for u in range(1, n + 1):
            add(id(t, u), id(t + 1, u), inf, 0)
        add(id(t + 1, 1), all_nodes - 1, inf, c * (t + 1))
    for t in range(all_nodes - 2):
        work(t)
    mcf = MinCostFlow(all_nodes - 1)
    mcf.work(0, all_nodes - 1)
    print(mcf.minw)

main()
